description: This file defines the PolicyErrorResponse class, which represents an error response related to a PolicyCommand in a policy management system. It wraps exceptions thrown during command processing and provides serialization/deserialization mechanisms, as well as metadata about the policy and the exception.

classes.name: PolicyErrorResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing an error response to a PolicyCommand, encapsulating the related policy ID and the exception that occurred, with mechanisms for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a PolicyErrorResponse from a DittoRuntimeException, with overloaded versions allowing specification of PolicyId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a PolicyErrorResponse from a JSON string or JsonObject.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this error response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource, which is empty in this implementation.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes additional payload data into a JSON object builder, including policy ID and exception details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyErrorResponse with specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality checks, ensuring type compatibility.
